name: Ichinose Honoka
source:
She's a little shy, but well liked. She spends quite a bit of time alone and it is well known that she loves cute animals.

But here's the thing. Animals don't seem to like her back. And while she's clearly a lovely girl, there's a real sadness to Honoka. To find out a truth about her, you will have to use your Kotodama power.

[From [url=https://kotodama.fandom.com/wiki/Honoka_Ichinose]Fandom[/url]]
